name: @devdigest/agent-runner
description: devdigest-agent-runner — the CI half of an exported agent. Runs inside .github/workflows/devdigest-review.yml on a TARGET repo (not this one): loads .devdigest/agents/<slug>.yaml and its skills from the checkout, computes its own diff, calls reviewer-core, posts the review via its own octokit client, and exits non-zero when countBlockers(findings, ci_fail_on) > 0. Never calls the studio.
